# E-Spanish

> > E-Spanish is a comprehensive online Spanish learning platform offering interactive grammar tests, vocabulary practice, audio lessons with native pronunciation, and cultural resources.

E-Spanish (e-spanyol.com) provides free Spanish language learning resources including a verb conjugator tool, grammar exercises, vocabulary drills, audio lessons with transcripts, comprehension tests, and access to Spanish-language radio stations from across Latin America and Spain. The platform emphasizes practical communication skills with pronunciation guides and interactive practice tools.

## Key Topics

- Spanish grammar
- Spanish vocabulary
- Pronunciation guide
- Verb conjugation
- Beginner Spanish
- Interactive exercises
- Audio lessons
- Listening comprehension
- Spanish phrases
- Grammar tests
- Word practice
- Spanish-language radio
- Language learning resources
- Native pronunciation
- Fill-in-the-blanks exercises

## Core Tools

- [Spanish Verb Conjugator](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-verb-conjugator.php): Spanish verb conjugator tool with reverse lookup for conjugated forms

## Grammar Lessons & Reference

- [Spanish Adjectives](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-grammar/adjectives.php): Grammar rules for Spanish adjective agreement and placement
- [Ser, Estar or Hay? Grammar Test](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-tests/test-11-ser-estar-hay.php): Fill-in-the-blanks test for ser, estar, and hay conjugation practice
- [Plural Form of Spanish Nouns Test](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-tests/test-09-spanish-noun-plural-forms.php): Grammar test for practicing Spanish noun plural formation rules
- [Practicing the Spanish Imperative](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-tests/exercise-02-spanish-imperative.php): Grammar exercise for practicing Spanish imperative mood and giving advice

## Pronunciation & Audio Lessons

- [The Alphabet (Abecedario)](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-audio/alphabet-abecedario.php): Complete Spanish alphabet with audio pronunciation and example words
- [Spanish Vowels](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-audio/vowels.php): Audio lesson on Spanish vowel pronunciation with transcript (A,E,I,O,U)
- [Giving Directions](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-audio/giving-directions.php): Audio lesson on navigation vocabulary and giving directions in Spanish

## Essential Phrases

- [Introduction & Telling Your Name](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-phrases/introduction-telling-your-name.php): Essential phrases for introductions and telling your name with audio
- [Understanding Each Other](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-phrases/understanding-each-other.php): Phrases for expressing comprehension difficulties with native audio

## Vocabulary Practice & Tests

- [Practice Numbers](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-vocabulary/practice-numbers.php): Interactive quiz tool for practicing Spanish numbers vocabulary
- [Practice Family & Relatives](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-vocabulary/practice-family-relatives.php): Interactive quiz for practicing family and relatives vocabulary
- [Sport Vocabulary](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-vocabulary/vocab-sports.php): Bilingual sports vocabulary list with pronunciation guide
- [Relatives - Who's Who?](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-tests/test-04-relatives-who-is-who.php): Family relationships vocabulary test for Spanish learners
- [What's the Time?](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-tests/test-14-what-is-the-time.php): Multiple-choice test for telling time in Spanish

## Listening Comprehension & Stories

- [Listening Comprehension Test](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-tests/test-07-listening-comprehension.php): Audio comprehension test with Mexican Spanish native speakers
- [Spanish Story: Pamplona Bull Run](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-stories/story-002.php): Pamplona San Fermín story with vocabulary help and comprehension test

## Spanish-Language Radio Stations

- [Colombian Radio Stations](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-radios/radio-colombia.php): Directory of Colombian radio stations including Caracol and La Mega
- [Dominican Republic Radio Stations](https://www.e-spanyol.com/spanish-radios/radio-dominica.php): Directory of Dominican Republic online radio stations with live streams
